title: Hip-Hop Birthday
description: A retro hip-hop build in primary red, blue, and yellow with black accents. A printed backdrop with a boombox and gold chain sits over a gold sequin skirt, flanked by balloon columns and starbursts; the same palette runs out into the room, with an oversized gold chain garland swagged along the balcony rail.

alt.retro-birthday-backdrop.jpg: A retro hip-hop birthday backdrop with a boombox and gold chain graphic over a gold sequin skirt, framed by red, blue, and yellow balloon columns
